messages:
Harper Lee: filing ticket #4219 - customer reports being billed twice after a streaming request timed out client-side and was retried. they included logs and said a toolcall fired once.
Gavin Brooks: paste the router trace + billing rows? curious if retry hit a different model variant/route.
Harper Lee: logs: initial stream -> eu-west (model:gpt-medium), client hit local timeout at chunk 5, retried, CDN routed to eu-central (model:gpt-small-fallback), server produced remaining tokens. ledger shows provisional grants from both routes and final confirmed for the resumed stream only. customer charged sum of both.
Mina Kaur: important: toolcall metadata shows tool.invoke=true on the confirmed stream only. webhook delivered once. so side effects only happened once, but tokens were granted twice.
Rohit Singh: current accounting model grants provisional tokens at segment allocation time per-route. when confirm arrives we mark those tokens confirmed for that route. cross-route retries can look like separate calls.
Lena (console): support sees two ledger rows with different model_ids and assumes two calls. we need better UX: provisional badge + show route_id and model_variant in the row detail. small patch.
Harper Lee: customer is asking for refund because both provisional rows were billed before confirm cleanup.
Gavin Brooks: billing question: do we ever retroactively zero provisional grants if confirm happens elsewhere?
billing-bot: policy-note: provisional grants are refundable after manual ops review. auto-refund requires finance/legal approval and deterministic correlation.
Mina Kaur: telemetry idea: emit events stream.segment.grant (route_id, model_variant, segment_id, provisional=true), stream.segment.confirm (segment_id, confirmed=true), and stream.toolcall.invoke with idempotency_token when applicable. also add stream.resume.token when client sends it.
Rohit Singh: good call. also include segment_hash: hash(first_16_tokens + salt) on grants for offline dedupe. high entropy to avoid collisions.
Gavin Brooks: reconcile algorithm draft: group provisional grants by (customer_id + client_session_id) if session present. fallback to (customer_id + segment_hash + time_window=75s) for non-session flows. Only suggest merge if toolcall.invoked=false OR toolcall.idempotency_token present and matches.
Harper Lee: client did not send client_session_id. but resume token present on retry. can we use resume token as correlate?
Mina Kaur: yes, emit stream.resume.attempt with resume_token and trace_id. reconcile worker can match grants that reference the same resume_token across routes.
Lena (console): UI plan: add provisional badge, route/model columns, and a "Find related provisional rows" action that runs reconcile heuristics and surfaces candidates with confidence (high/med/low). support can escalate high-confidence to billing ops. ETA 3d for MVP.
Rohit Singh: infra change: when router hands off a session we could emit lease_transfer events with original route_id and active_segment_ids so the new route doesn't re-grant overlapping prefixes. heavier lift; consider for Dedicated only.
Gavin Brooks: danger: collision on short prompts if we rely only on prompt-prefix. segment_hash mitigates this. ensure all grants include customer_id + segment_hash + route_id.
Mina Kaur: also: never auto-merge if any candidate row has toolcall.invoke=true unless idempotency token proves single invocation. finance will require strong audit trail.
billing-bot: reminder: loop in legal/finance before putting any auto-merge or auto-refund in prod.
Harper Lee: action items: (1) Mina - add telemetry events + segment_hash (ETA: next sprint). (2) Lena - console provisional badge + "find related" action (ETA: 3d). (3) Rohit - seed RFC for lease_transfer for Dedicated (ETA: EOW). (4) Gavin - draft conservative reconcile RFC with audit trail and heuristics (ETA: 1wk). I'll update the customer with interim explanation and offer manual billing review.
Lena (console): opening a Figma quick mock now, will PR after reviews.
Mina Kaur: adding toolcall.idempotency_token to toolcall events as well so billing can correlate external side effects.
Gavin Brooks: leaving this open until reconcile RFC + console patch land.
